title: Fees Collected in Full with a Home-Site Lease Repayment Down Payment
content:
**Ledger bulletin — fees taken in full with the down payment of a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement**

Which fees are collected in full with the down payment depends on the fees on the covered balance:

| Fees on the lease | Collected in full | The down-payment percentage applies to |
|---|---|---|
| a returned-payment fee posted on the lease within the past month | every late fee of the most recent billing period and every such returned-payment fee | the rest of the covered balance |
| no such returned-payment fee, but a late fee posted for the most recent billing period | that late fee | the rest of the covered balance |
| neither | nothing | the whole covered balance |

The down payment is the fees collected in full plus the down-payment percentage of the rest of the covered balance, that percentage part rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figures** (hypothetical: covered balance 1,482.50; down-payment percentage 20.0; a late fee of 41.25 for the most recent billing period)

| Case | Collected in full | Rest of the covered balance | Percentage part | Down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a returned-payment fee of 35.00 posted two weeks ago | 41.25 plus 35.00: 76.25 | 1,406.25 | 281.25 | 357.50 |
| no returned-payment fee in the past month | 41.25 | 1,441.25 | 288.25 | 329.50 |
| no returned-payment fee in the past month and no late fee for the most recent period | nothing | 1,482.50 | 296.50 | 296.50 |

A returned-payment fee posted more than a month before is not "within the past month" and is not collected in full under the first row.
